assessment.description: Your independent read of what the worker just did: what was real, what was weak, what was missed.

directive.description: The exact next instruction to inject into the worker. Concrete, specific, actionable — like a rally co-driver's call. Never 'keep going'; always say WHAT to do next and HOW.

corrections.description: Specific mistakes, wrong assumptions, or fabrications to correct. Empty array if none.

new_angles.description: Fresh ideas, untried angles, or connections between clues. Empty array if none.

exhaustion_breaker.description: If the surface looks exhausted, the concrete NEW expansion strategy (more recon, a new attack class, a bypass, deeper JS/schema analysis, research). Empty string if not exhausted.

scope_enforcement.description: User-constraint violations to flag and how to correct course. Empty array if none.

severity_validations.description: Independent severity verdicts for any new findings. Empty array if none this turn.

to_user.description: A short, high-signal status line for the human watching. Empty string if nothing to say.

continue.description: Almost always true. False ONLY on a hard scope/authorization/ethics violation that forbids continuing.

stop_reason.description: Justification if continue is false; empty string otherwise.
